source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
# 3. For any record with a failing test, generate a new document by filling out the product performance report form.
4. Print or save the form to a permanent record.
5. Take photos of any failed advertisement signs and labels, and print or save them to the permanent record.
6. Take photos of any failed user manuals or instructions, and print or save them to the permanent record.
7. Make a list of the failed advertisement signs and labels, and print or save it to the permanent record.
8. Make a list of the failed user manuals or instructions, and print or save it to the permanent record.<eos>
